instruction: Using Thunderbird, configure a message filter on the anonym-x2024@outlook.com account to forward all incoming mail to 'backup@archive.com'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a Thunderbird message filter that forwards all incoming messages to a backup address. The evaluator uses the existing check_thunderbird_filter metric to verify the filter is created with 'Forward' action, actionValue set to 'backup@archive.com', and condition set to 'ALL' (matches all messages). This is very similar to the original task with a different destination email address.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly fetches the account-specific Thunderbird filter configuration file from the correct VM path
Metric function check_thunderbird_filter properly parses the msgFilterRules.dat format and extracts all filter properties (enabled, action, actionValue, condition)
Complete instruction coverage: verifies filter is enabled, has Forward action, correct destination email (backup@archive.com), and matches all incoming messages (condition=['ALL'])
Account specificity verified: file path includes outlook.office365.com which corresponds to the anonym-x2024@outlook.com account
Postconfig appropriately closes Message Filters window and waits for file to be written to disk
Correct parameter handling: metric receives rules dict directly (not wrapped) when expected.type='rule', accesses it correctly with rules.get('expect', [])
Logic is robust: checks all expected filters exist and none of the unexpected filters are present

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
